responsibility: Provides shared AST utility support used by parsing, literal handling, comment processing, and source validation. This module brings together parser-oriented helpers for case-sensitive recovery settings, syntactic classification of expressions and types, and operator/fixity precedence metadata; literal utilities that convert lexer literals into AST forms and back while validating and unescaping their contents; comment utilities that classify, store, detect, normalize, and test doc-comment text; and Unicode scanning helpers for detecting text-flow control characters in source. Together these files supply the common low-level interpretation and normalization logic that lets the parser and AST layer reason consistently about source syntax, literals, comments, and text properties.
